card.name: Partway through multiword medical terms
card.fires_on: Inside or right after the first part of a multiword medical term, where the next piece is predictable. Examples are the OP of ROP, PDT, monoclonal, and oral before contraceptive.

modes.description: An adjective such as oral or general that sits before a head noun like contraceptive or anesthesia.
modes.example: maintenance of<< general>> anesthesia, maintenance dosing of rocur
